title: At least one search parameter must be set, and filters don't count
claim: A request with no search parameter is refused outright — even one that sets paging or filter parameters. `contactMode` is a filter, not a search parameter, so it alone does not satisfy the requirement either.

entries.text: Paging alone is not a search.

errors.text: This endpoint requires at least one search parameter to be set.

entries.text: contactMode filters results but does not count as a search parameter.
